newsitem.title: USA: McCrory seeks assets sale to CEO-controlled firm.
newsitem.headline: McCrory seeks assets sale to CEO-controlled firm.

text.p: McCrory Corp said late Tuesday that is seeking to sell its assets to a company to be formed and controlled by Meshulam Riklis, McCrory's chairman and chief executive officer, for $51 million plus the assumptionof certain liabilities.
McCrory said it has filed a motion with the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of New York to sell its assets as a going-concern to the Riklis-controlled company.
The proposal is subject to higher and better offers during an auction at a hearing before the Bankruptcy Court scheduled for July 24, 1997.
